PermissionSet.description: SMF-11 probe: lets a user call the markup revision endpoint (read latest, save with conflict detection). Grants no record, object or File access; Case and File visibility still come from the SMF-3 baseline sharing. Assign to MF-TECH, MF-SUPPORT and MF-RESTRICTED alike so denials are decided by sharing, not by Apex class access.
PermissionSet.label: SMF-11 Markup Probe Access
